findings.title: Failed-only audit accepts impossible observation states
findings.problem: validated⇒received&&settled is one-sided. audit_partial also permits received=true/settled=false/validated=false; its unreceived branch permits an unsettled initial row with a nonnull category or writeState. The source has no await between actual response capture/catch/finally, and initial rows assign all those nullable facts null.
findings.impact: A fabricated failed report can be labelled CONFORMING_FAILED_PARTIAL_NO_CREDIT despite impossible source facts. No positive/private/public/cumulative credit or successful callback acceptance is enabled by this gap.
findings.minimalCorrection: Add received⇒settled and constrain unreceived+unsettled category/writeState to null. Preserve actual nullable writeState on settled rejection and all existing categories, schema, finite path, aggregates, raw/no-credit policy. Extend existing D03 finite subcases; do not add a callback, execution attempt, cap, deadline or category.
findings.verification: Static full source/control-flow and predicate inspection only; no reviewed function or synthetic control executed.
findings.status: OPEN for root disposition and separately released correction; helper3 unchanged
